text:
Are you from a country that doesn't allow dual citizenship? Because Israel doesn't require those in the partner-visa process (or those making Aliyah) to give up their original citizenship - no need to give a reason or anything, it's not a big deal - you can just keep it :) Otherwise, if you want to just get permanent residency for any other reason, it's not really a problem at all - I know people who have done that.

Also, if you have done four years on A5, citizenship via the partner-visa process is almost certainly going to be quicker and easier than making Aliyah after a reform conversion.
